sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x swipe cards, 2x bodyvests, 1x Ops phone, 2x bodycams, 2x bodycam chargers. All photos/video involving incidents attached following end of shift.
Alpha Route commenced. Patrol along Queen Street to maintain visible security presence.
Durham Street inspected for vagrants occupying public property. No persons of concern located.
Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Wyndham Street. Area inspected and found clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Shortland Street. Welfare checks on businesses within the vicinity. All clear.
Walkthrough completed at Pocket Park. No vagrants or issues identified.
Welfare check conducted at McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Full area inspection, then welfare checks along Rutland Street and Tyler Street. No issues identified.
Stationed at TK Square to maintain visible presence while remaining available for response calls.
Departed standby position and resumed patrol duties.
Welfare check conducted at Albert Street Bus Terminal. Area clear. Businesses within the vicinity remained closed.
Arrived at the intersection of Customs Street and Albert Street. No issues identified.
Welfare checks completed at Albert Mart and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Swanson Street and Albert Street. No issues observed.
Patrol conducted through Federal Square and the surrounding Cathedral precinct. No concerns identified.
Arrived at the intersection of Albert Street and Wyndham Street. Welfare checks completed at Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Cafe. All clear.
Welfare checks conducted at Little Albert's Cafe, Formery, Sky Mart Convenience Store, and The People's Barista. No issues identified.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks on businesses. All clear. Presence maintained.
Departed area and resumed patrol duties.
Welfare checks conducted at AA Insurance, City Convenience Store, and Mr Barber Shop. All clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Albert Street and Wellesley Street. No issues observed.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full sweep completed. Welfare checks at Jack's Fried Chicken and the Aotea Centre. All clear.
Visible presence maintained while remaining available for response calls.
Alpha Route concluded. Delta Route commenced.
Welfare checks completed at Auckland Town Hall, Queens Food Court, and businesses along Upper Queen Street. All clear.
Arrived at the top of Mayoral Drive. Area inspected for concerns. None identified.
Walkthrough conducted along Wakefield Street; businesses checked. All clear.
Walkthrough completed around Auckland Library. Premises closed. No vagrants or rough sleepers present.
Arrived at the intersection of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street. Welfare checks along Lorne Street and surrounding water fountain area. All clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Lorne Street and High Street. No issues. Patrol continued along High Street with welfare checks.
Walkthrough completed at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. No issues observed.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Full sweep completed with no issues. Presence maintained.
Departed area. No incidents to this point. Returned to headquarters for scheduled morning interval and restroom break.
Arrived at headquarters and remained available for response calls.
Morning interval completed. Patrol duties resumed.
Welfare check conducted at Starbucks. All clear. Patrol continued along Queen Street.
Arrived at Wilson Parking. Welfare checks on businesses within the location. All clear.
Arrived at the lower end of Fort Street. Welfare checks on businesses and premises. All clear. Presence maintained.
Departed area and resumed patrol duties.
Response call received from management requesting assistance at headquarters.
Welfare checks conducted at 77 Convenience Store and The Coffee Club. All clear.
Arrived at Kiwibank. Area inspected for concerns. No issues identified.
Arrived at headquarters and proceeded upstairs to the office for a brief meeting.
Meeting concluded. Visible presence maintained at the bottom of headquarters.
Delta Route concluded. Charlie Route commenced.
Arrived at the intersection of Victoria Street and Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare checks conducted throughout Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street. No issues identified.
Arrived at the intersection of Albert Street and Victoria Street. Welfare checks on stores. All clear.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks on all businesses. All clear. Presence maintained.
Departed area and continued patrols towards the next checkpoint.
Welfare checks conducted at AA Insurance, City Convenience Store, and Mr Barber. All clear.
Welfare checks commenced along Crowne Plaza Hotel, down towards Atrium on Elliott. All clear.
Returned to headquarters and commenced lunch break while preparing for handover.
Morning shift completed. Equipment handover completed.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Afternoon shift deployed. Equipment handover completed.
Response call received from Doshan, 131 Queen Street, regarding a male vagrant sitting in front of the store. Footage uploaded on bodycam.
Arrived at 131 Queen Street. Guards informed the male vagrant he could not sit outside and needed to move along; he complied. Presence maintained.
Returned to headquarters to charge Ops phone due to low battery.
Response call received from Hallensteins Queen Street regarding a suspicious male who may have been attempting to steal. Guards proceeded.
Arrived at Hallensteins Queen Street. Manager requested guards remain present while the male was trying on clothing.
Male attempted to walk out of the store wearing items he had not paid for. Guards stopped him and instructed him to remove the clothing; he complied. Presence maintained.
Male POI left the store. Presence maintained.
Returned to headquarters to charge Ops phone as battery remained low.
Response call received from Tatty's Designer Recycle regarding an individual who had stolen from the store. Guards proceeded.
Arrived at Tatty's. Manager provided photo and description of the female individual. Guards advised they would keep an eye out while patrolling.
Patrol continued down towards Fort Street.
Arrived at Fort Street check-in. Welfare checks completed at Right Track, KFC, Vape Haven, Evans Kebab, Walker & Hall, and Jo & Joe. All clear. Presence maintained.
Response call received from Tatty's advising the female individual who had stolen earlier was spotted along High Street.
Guards located the female POI at the bottom of Vulcan Lane. Asked for the stolen items back; nothing was found on her.
Tatty's informed no stolen items were found. Female POI issued a verbal trespass from the store.
Returned to headquarters to charge Ops phone (9%). Battery displayed on office camera.
Response call received from Cotton On regarding a female POI who had stolen from the store. Photo and description provided. Evening shift team informed.
Female POI spotted on a bus by the evening shift team. Team stopped the bus and retrieved the stolen goods.
Arrived at Cotton On Queen Street to return the recovered stolen goods. Photo provided.
Returned to headquarters (Ops phone 6%). Battery displayed on office camera.
Geared up to commence patrols. Echo Route commenced.
Arrived at Darby Street check-in. Welfare checks at Celine Mediterranean Cuisine, Mali Thai, Pizza Club, Tandoori, Domino's, and Tank. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. Welfare checks at The Fiddler, 77 Convenience Store, Mr Tacos, and Vphix Mobiles. All clear. Presence maintained.
Arrived at Wyndham Street. Welfare checks at Ace Karaoke and Good To Go Supermarket. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Wyndham Street. Welfare checks at Chemist Warehouse, QF Tavern, and Ibis Budget Hotel. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Commercial Bay sweep completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Arrived at Fort Street check-in. Welfare checks at Right Track, Vape Haven, KFC, and Jo & Joe. All clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Square and Chancery Square check-in.
Freyberg Square and Chancery Square sweep completed. All clear. Echo Route ended.
Arrived at bottom of Victoria Street East. Presence maintained.
Arrived at bottom of Queen Street.
Arrived at bottom of Albert Street. Welfare check at Albert Mart. All clear. Taking cover due to rain.
Arrived at St Patrick's Square check-in.
St Patrick's Square sweep completed. All clear. Remaining available for response calls.
Routes recommenced along Albert Street. Welfare check at Ace Karaoke completed while passing. All clear.
Arrived at corner of Albert Street and Victoria Street West. Welfare check at Sky Mart completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Arrived at Te Waihorotiu train station. Welfare check completed with guard. All clear.
Aotea Square sweep completed. All clear. Returning to headquarters for 30-minute break.
Awaiting handover while remaining available for response calls.
Afternoon shift completed. Handover to night shift completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Night shift deployed. Equipment received: 3x bodyvests, 2x keycards, 1x Ops phone, 4x set of keys, 1x bodycam, and 1x Ops phone charger.
Alpha Route commenced. Check-in completed at Chemist Warehouse and Kathmandu. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Vulcan Lane. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Britomart. No issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay. Full sweep commenced.
Commercial Bay full sweep completed. All clear, no issues. Streets quiet tonight.
Check-in completed at Albert Street Convenience Store. No issues.
Check-in completed at 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Victoria Street. All clear, no issues.
Floor checks completed. Ops phone placed on charge as battery was at 5%.
Patrolling Aotea Square. Full sweep commenced.
Aotea Square full sweep completed. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Queen Street. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, and Kitchener Street. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep completed at Fort Street and Wilson Carpark. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Gore Street. All clear. Due to weather, surfaces were wet and slippery; patrol continued with caution.
Check-in completed at St Patrick's Cathedral Church. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Victoria Street. Road workers present, no issues to report.
Check-in completed at corner of Lorne Street and Wakefield Street. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Aotea Square. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Queen Street. No issues.
Check-in completed at Elliott Street and Wilson Carpark. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Durham Street. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep completed at Wyndham Street. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, and Kitchener Street. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Fort Street and Wilson Carpark. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Britomart and Commercial Bay. No issues to report.
Check-in completed at St Patrick's Cathedral Church. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Check-in completed at Aotea Square. All clear, no issues.
